svg.aria-label: From the private desk: Cerebro: Parses Java/Spring repos into a typed code graph and exposes it to AI agents as 41 MCP tools.; Landskape: Browser control plane for a GKE fleet, with an embedded AI copilot and its own MCP server.; Job Orchestrator: Airflow-style DAG workflow engine: 17 modules, virtual threads, live run monitoring.; Orbit CI/CD: Reusable GitHub Actions framework with auto-semver and gated promotions, running across 10+ repos.
